sections.heading: Sriperumbudur: From Hyundai's Plant to an Electronics Corridor
paragraphs: Sriperumbudur's industrial story starts on 6 May 1996, when Hyundai Motor India was formed as a wholly owned subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Company and built its plant at Irungattukottai, just outside the town on the Chennai–Bengaluru highway. The Santro launched from there on 23 September 1998, and Wikipedia records that within months Hyundai Motor India was the country's second-largest car maker and largest car exporter; it produced 777,876 vehicles in 2024. Component suppliers followed along the SIPCOT estates at Irungattukottai and Oragadam, and the belt between Sriperumbudur and Oragadam became one of India's main vehicle-building corridors.

Electronics came next. Wikipedia's list of companies with plants in and around Sriperumbudur includes Dell, Foxconn, Samsung, Saint-Gobain, Salcomp, Sanmina, Motorola, Nokia, Nissan, Mitsubishi, Royal Enfield and Yamaha, and in July 2023 Foxconn announced a Rs 1,600 crore investment in Tamil Nadu to make mobile phone components. India Briefing's 2026 guide describes the corridor as moving from assembly toward technology-intensive manufacturing, with direct access to Chennai Port, Ennore Port and Chennai airport, and notes a pharmaceutical formulation and API presence that draws on Tamil Nadu's wider life-sciences base.

sections.heading: What Electronics and Vehicle Plants in Sriperumbudur Buy in Electropolished Tube
paragraphs: Neither an electronics assembly plant nor a car plant is a hygienic plant, so this page should be precise about where our tube fits. In electronics manufacturing it is the clean utilities: deionised and high-purity rinse water loops for board and component washing, clean compressed air and nitrogen to assembly and test lines, process cooling, and the chemical lines of plating, anodising and surface-treatment shops. A mechanically polished bore keeps shedding fines and holds biofilm; electropolishing removes that cold-worked layer, lowers the Ra and leaves a chromium-rich passive film, so the water and gas reaching a point of use carry what the filter lets through, not what the tube adds.

In a vehicle or component plant the demand is smaller and more specific: paint-shop pretreatment and e-coat chemical dosing, DI water for paint and battery lines, and instrument sample lines on utility boilers and compressors. Glass-making, which Saint-Gobain does near Sriperumbudur, adds analyser and impulse tube on furnace and gas systems. In all of these, SF4 316L to ASME BPE surface designations covers water, gas and product-contact lines, SF1 304L or 316L covers plain utilities, and 904L, which we supply electropolished, covers acid pickling, anodising and chloride-bearing chemical lines.

sections.heading: Grade and Finish for a Sriperumbudur Utility Line List
paragraphs: Treat the DI and ultrapure water loop as the product line of an electronics plant. It should be SF4 316L, sloped to drain with short dead legs and orbitally welded, because a resistivity or TOC excursion on a rinse loop stops the line as surely as a product defect does. Clean compressed air and nitrogen drops to test floors deserve the same finish, with capped and bagged tube kept sealed until installation. Cooling water, plant air and general transfer can be SF1 mechanically polished 304L.

For the pharmaceutical formulation and API units in the wider corridor, the usual split applies: SF4 316L on purified water and WFI distribution, product transfer and CIP return, SF1 on utilities, and 904L on aggressive process chemistry. We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L.

sections.heading: Vendor Documents for SIPCOT Plants and Their Contractors
paragraphs: Multinational plants in the SIPCOT estates buy through vendor-qualification systems, and our documents are built for them. Each heat carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory, every length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

If the plant's engineering standard or its EPC contractor's inspection plan calls for additional testing, third-party witness or a defined marking format, state it in the enquiry so the quotation already covers it.

sections.heading: Sending a Sriperumbudur RFQ
paragraphs: We quote within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For plants at Irungattukottai, Oragadam or the Sriperumbudur SIPCOT estates, please send:
bullets: The plant type and system: DI or ultrapure water loop, clean air or nitrogen, plating or pretreatment chemical line, cooling water, a pharma water loop, or an analyser or impulse line, and whether you are the owner, an EPC contractor or a skid or panel builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for high-purity water, clean gas and product contact; SF1 304L or 316L for utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride chemistry.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312, and the point-of-use fittings they must suit.
Cleanliness and packaging requirements (capped, bagged), any inspection plan, and the delivery address in the SIPCOT estate.
